instrument ToF_Spectrometer

  # Constants and derived quantities
  double lambda = 4.14
  double dlambda = 0.075

  double VS2E = 81.81
  double LMM = 0.030
  double LME = 2.1
  double LED = 2.483
  double LCE = 0.395
  double LCC = 0.2
  double DM = 3.355
  double RV = 3
  double el_t_resol = 0.125
  double iTOF_CHA_RESOL = 128
  double iRATIO = 1
  double iELPEAK = ceil(iTOF_CHA_RESOL/2)
  double iCHA_WIDTH = 0
  double iSPEED = 0
  double iPHASE = 0
  double iTOF_DELAY = 0
  double dead_time = 0
  double period = 0
  double chan_width = 0
  double time_of_flight = 0
  double trav_time = 0
  double delta_phase = 0
  double ref_phas = 0
  double phase_offset = 0
  double el_peak_O = 0
  double tmin = 0
  double tmax = 0

  # Compute derived quantities
  double Ki = 2 * PI / lambda
  double vi = K2V * fabs(Ki)
  double Ei = VS2E * vi * vi
  double theta = asin(lambda / (DM * 2))
  double A2 = theta * 2
  double A1 = atan2(LME * sin(A2), (LME * cos(A2) + LMM)) * RAD2DEG
  double A3 = atan2(LME * sin(A2), (LME * cos(A2) - LMM)) * RAD2DEG
  A2 *= RAD2DEG
  A2cradle = A2
  if (A1 < 0.0) A1 = 180 + A1
  if (A2 < 0.0) A2 = 180 + A2
  if (A3 < 0.0) A3 = 180 + A3

  # Compute chopper parameters
  if (M1 == 0) A1 = 0 else if (M1 >= 0) A1 = -0.0210199 * M1 + 178.55 else M1 = -(A1 - 178.55) / 0.0210199
  if (M2 == 0) A2 = 0 else if (M2 >= 0) A2 = -0.0210302 * M2 + 182.558 else M2 = -(A2 - 182.558) / 0.0210302
  if (M3 == 0) A3 = 0 else if (M3 >= 0) A3 = -0.0206945 * M3 + 187.566 else M3 = -(A3 - 187.566) / 0.0206945

  # Chopper speed calculation
  double chopper_const = 252.77
  if (SPEED < 0) {
    iSPEED = 60 * K2V / (DM * cos(theta) * (LCE + LED * pow((1 - dE / Ei), -1.5)))
    period = 0.5e6 * iRATIO / iSPEED
    chan_width = floor(period / el_t_resol / iTOF_CHA_RESOL) * el_t_resol
    dead_time = period - (iTOF_CHA_RESOL * chan_width)
    time_of_flight = (0.07 + LCC + LCE + LED) / vi * 1e6
    trav_time = LCC / vi * 1e6
    delta_phase = (trav_time / period) * 180
    iPHASE = ref_phas + delta_phase
    if (fmod(iRATIO, 2) == 0) iPHASE *= 2
    iPHASE += phase_offset
    el_peak_O = floor((time_of_flight + el_delay) / chan_width)
    if (iELPEAK >= el_peak_O) iTOF_DELAY += period
    if (iTOF_DELAY <= 1) iTOF_DELAY = 2
    if (PHASE > -180 && PHASE < 360) iPHASE = PHASE
    if (CHA_WIDTH <= 0) iCHA_WIDTH = chan_width
    if (TOF_DELAY <= 0) iTOF_DELAY = delay
    if (SPEED < 0) iSPEED = speed
    Frequency = iSPEED / 60
    tmin = time_of_flight * 1e-6 - (iCHA_WIDTH * iELPEAK - iTOF_DELAY) * 1e-6
    tmax = tmin + iTOF_CHA_RESOL * iCHA_WIDTH * 1e-6
  }
